patterns: The 'famous IP, but it's 1975' series is now a format: techhalla's 'Breaking Bad but it's 1975' (40.0K views, 954 likes) and 'Lord of the Rings (1975)' (21.5K) follow 'The Walking Dead but it's 1974' (251.9K) from 11-08. Title of six words or fewer, the clip does the rest.
Adding the how-to raises saves: the LOTR post with 'how to make your own with Magnific below' got 115 bookmarks on 21.5K views, versus 146 on 40.0K for the post without one.
Historical 'what if' VFX travels: minchoi's 'AI reimagines how the pyramids were built' (39.0K) and several outsider 'giants building the pyramids' Seedance clips on the same theme.
Prompt shares earn the best bookmark ratio: azed_ai's Notion-style illustration prompt got 106 bookmarks on 5.3K views (about 2%).
Model-vs-model comparisons pull views but not likes: fotor_com's Seedance 2.5 vs Kling 4.0 got 69.9K views and 52 likes; MayorKingAI's Seedream vs GPT Image got 10.9K and 78 likes.

virals_narrative: Monday split between AI news and the '70s remake' format. minchoi's thread on Anthropic's Fable 5.2 + Mythos 5.2 led with 187.5K views and 551 bookmarks, and his 'AI reimagines how the pyramids were built' clip added 39.0K. techhalla kept the franchise-meets-era series going for a third day: 'Breaking Bad but it's 1975' (40.0K views, 954 likes) and 'Lord of the Rings (1975)' with a Magnific how-to (21.5K, 115 bookmarks). Below that: MayorKingAI's Seedream 5.5 vs GPT Image 2.6 comparison (10.9K), AIWarper's MiniMax H3 Image early-access test (8.9K), and three azed_ai posts (3D character, --sref, a Notion-style prompt share with 106 bookmarks on 5.3K views). 11 hits ≥5K, 6 ★. Outside the watchlist the sample was thin: model-vs-model comparisons (fotor_com's Seedance 2.5 vs Kling 4.0, 69.9K views but only 52 likes) and more 'pyramids built by giants' clips.

drafts.draft_en:
Gladiator was 1975. Breaking Bad was 1975.

So I did House of David, but it's 1975.

Grain, painted skies, crash zooms. Full AI VFX breakdown below 👇
drafts.video_tip: 15-20s 70s Technicolor montage: open on your strongest epic wide shot in the first 2s, heavy grain and warm halation, 1.85 letterbox, end on a fake vintage title card. Put a 3-step how-to in the first reply so it gets saved.

drafts.draft_en:
How were the pyramids really built?

I asked AI to show it as a VFX shot.

Giants, cranes of light, or just a lot of people. Which version do you believe?
drafts.video_tip: 10-15s: three 4s variants of the same pyramid wide shot (giants, sci-fi beams, realistic crowd) with a number on each; end card 'Vote 1, 2 or 3 👇'.

drafts.draft_en:
Make your own 1975 movie remake in 3 steps:

1. Style frame in Firefly or Midjourney
2. Upscale + film grain in Magnific
3. Animate in Kling or Seedance

Prompt in the reply. Show me yours.
drafts.video_tip: 12s before/after: the clean modern frame, then the 1975 version, then the animated shot; overlay 'Step 1/2/3' labels. Pin the full prompt as the first reply.

drafts.draft_en:
Prompt share: 70s epic film still.

'A 1975 Technicolor film still of [scene], anamorphic lens, heavy grain, warm halation, painted matte background, practical smoke, 35mm.'

Drop your results 👇
drafts.video_tip: 8-10s: a 4-image grid of results from the prompt, each cutting to a 2s animated version; full prompt as text in the post so bookmarks carry it.

drafts.draft_en:
Saturday Challenge: your favourite film, but it's 1975.

Any AI tool. Grain, practical effects, painted skies.

Post it under this tweet, I'll feature the best ones next week.
drafts.video_tip: 6-10s example: your own 1975 remake clip with a vintage title card, then a 'YOUR TURN' end card with the rules in 3 short lines.
